claims.statement: Supplier-side filing (Liberty Energy Q3 2026 earnings release furnished on 8-K, 2026-10-21): Liberty Power Innovations (LPI) entered into a strategic development agreement with a leading frontier AI lab and a dedicated infrastructure platform for 1.2 GW of integrated power services at data center campuses; the agreement includes a significant prepayment of capacity fees by the customer side, targets execution of the first ~500 MW energy service agreement by December 2026, and sets phased energization from Q4 2027 through Q1 2029; additional projects at other sites include gas supply, interconnection, permitting and construction planning. The AI lab is not named; the prepayment amount is not disclosed in the filing.

sources.locator: Summary Results and Highlights 第 6 點
sources.quote: Executed a strategic development agreement with a leading frontier AI lab and a dedicated infrastructure platform to deliver 1.2 GW of integrated power services at data center campuses

Liberty Power Innovations (“LPI”) entered into a strategic development agreement with a leading frontier AI lab and a dedicated infrastructure platform for 1.2 GW of integrated power services at data center campuses.
The agreement includes a significant prepayment of capacity fees and targeted execution of the first energy service agreement (“ESA”) contract for approximately 500 megawatts ("MW") by December 2026.
The agreement also establishes a phased energization schedule from Q4 2027 through Q1 2029 and includes the substantive commercial terms for the additional long-term ESAs.

We see significant opportunity to expand this relationship and are already working together to advance additional projects across other sites, including gas supply, interconnection, permitting and construction planning.
